_comment_vm_ssh_user: Login user the tenant gets on the instance (Debian cloud images ship "debian"). vmaccess.sh sets this user's password and enables sshd password logins; templates built before vmaccess.sh existed simply report no VM credentials.
_comment_dbaas_dir: Where the provisioning scripts live inside the template image. Only change it if you build images that install them elsewhere; the scripts themselves honour a DBAAS_DIR environment variable with the same default.
_comment_ssh_connect_timeout_seconds: Applied to paramiko's timeout, banner_timeout AND auth_timeout together. Setting only timeout is not enough: banner_timeout and auth_timeout keep their own 15s defaults, so a slow-to-answer sshd still fails at 15s no matter how large this is. See TEMPLATES.md for the offering sizing that makes those timeouts matter.
_comment_engines: Template name -> provisioning scripts + port. Add a new engine here and drop its scripts into every dbaas-* image's /opt/dbaas/ (see TEMPLATES.md) -- never hardcode this mapping in the Python source.
_comment_provision_mode: How the engine is configured after deployment. "ssh": the management server connects to the instance and runs the script above -- needs a route to port 22. "configdrive": the instance configures itself at first boot from the config drive, and the management server never connects to it. Templates built before the config-drive script existed must stay on "ssh"; the default when the key is absent is "ssh".
